law_record.title: Posted places (A)(2)
law_record.text: No person shall stop, stand or park a vehicle except when necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic in compliance with law or the directions of a police officer or a traffic control device, in any of the following places: At any place or in any space adjacent to a curb which has been designated and posted as a fire lane pursuant to the City's Fire Code, whether the vehicle is attended or unattended and whether the location is on public or private property.

activation_conditions: the place or space adjacent to the curb is designated and posted as a fire lane
the subject stops, stands or parks there
exceptions: when necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic
in compliance with the directions of a police officer or a traffic control device
residue: the rule reaches private property as well as public, which a map keyed to public roads may not represent
summary.subject: driver

timing_requirements.requirement: judged for every instant at rest in the fire lane, attended or not
